provenance.existing: Parts and direct costs are read from balance.json recipes. No manufacturer fields are changed.
provenance.new: All resources, hours, salaries, demand, prices, investments and scenarios below are original game design candidates, awaiting user preference and playtesting.
provenance.procurementChannels: Single confirmed order line must meet same-SKU minimum quantity. Separate orders never accumulate or receive retroactive discounts. Channel definitions are read from design/supplier-system.json. Confirmed by user on 2026-10-07.
provenance.difficultyTerms: opening.<difficulty>.supplierTermsFactor multiplies parts cost only. It represents supplier terms for a new small company and is a game assumption, not a historical price finding.
provenance.limits: A deterministic scenario calculator, not a playable six-month balance validation. Demand, delivery timing and quality feedback are assumptions.

limitations: Capacity checks use monthly totals and owner design hours, not a dependency-aware event schedule.
The owner performs design; employees and owner share other work. Only owner design availability is separately checked.
Delivery costs are in direct costs. Lead times, release-day bottlenecks, component lots, returns, quality and reputation are not simulated.
Stock retains historical cost. No markdown, resale, demand adaptation, depreciation or equipment residual value is modeled.
Existing recipe variants are sold at assumed prices and all valid commissioned orders pay on completion.
Demand is an assumed company sales ceiling, not a validated market forecast. First prototypes are sold, not discarded.
